content.short: Altura offers stablecoin deposits earning yield sourced from onchain strategies.
content.description: Altura takes USDT0 deposits on HyperEVM and runs them through a single multi-strategy vault, so a depositor holds one share balance and no separate positions. Deposits can arrive from any EVM-compatible wallet, with the protocol handling the bridging. Shares represent an exact ownership percentage of the vault, and the return combines a base yield with ALTU token rewards. Strategy execution and rebalancing run in the background without depositor action.
